name: HDR-HexPlane
aliases: Fast High Dynamic Range Radiance Fields for Dynamic Scenes
definition: An end-to-end neural radiance field framework for dynamic scenes that learns 3D scene representations from dynamic 2D images captured with various exposures, allowing for novel view synthesis with adjustable exposure levels.
summary: HDR-HexPlane is a fast neural radiance field framework for dynamic scenes that learns 3D representations from multi-exposure images to enable novel view synthesis with adjustable exposure levels.
